The Empty Flask (wcid 7940 flasksimple, ItemType 0x400000 CraftCookingBase, Value 1, MaxStackSize 1, so each one takes a slot; one is left by each potion she drinks, about 13 an hour) is in no other listed vendor's mask; ACE pays max(1, floor(0.9 x 1 + 0.1)) = 1 pyreal a flask (Vendor.cs GetBuyCost 591-599 @95ef426d). His MerchandiseMinValue (int 75) is 0 and his MerchandiseMaxValue (int 76) 1,000,000, and ACE's sale reads neither (Player_Commerce.cs VerifySellItems 232-298 @95ef426d: the mask, IsSellable, Retained, a Value of 1 or more, an empty container). Her drinks (the Mana Potion 379, the Potion of Healing 377, the Health and Mana Tinctures 27319 and 27322) are Misc 0x80, outside his mask, and the sale keeps every drink she uses whatever a mask takes (ResupplyRun.DrinkInUse, m6-sale-keeps-drinks); a pack (Container) and a trade note are never offered (ResupplyRun.SaleItems). His stop is his own cell as Thelnoth's, Ecutha's and Monyra's are (the station's request stops ShopLeg.UnseenVendorReachMetres short of his point): the dat tests walk every vendor of the den's profile from Holtburg's lifestone, his leg among them (ResupplyRouteDatTests: the room graph's path, about 32 m, enters his shop through the room 0xA9B4016E and ends in 0xA9B4016A; VendorStopConfirmDatTests: the walker's pre-check confirms it and his point stands on the floor through the statics, and The_stations_walk_from_the_lifestone_to_the_Grocer_enters_his_shop_and_passes_the_pre_check plans the station's own request, his point with that range); the shop's two doors (0x7A9B401E and 0x7A9B401F, world objects the dats do not hold) and his body are not in those tests, and the walk to him has not been run live (TODO(m6-grocer-stop-point)). They are wares only, no stock line: the learn step's shopping list buys a component by the vendor's row, and the loader takes a spell component as a ware without a supply line (GroundCatalog.CheckSupplies); whether a trip keeps them in the pack for the recall is TODO(m6-recall-components-stock). sources.supplies: M6 14 (m6-life-through): Harm Other I to IV add Mandrake 775 and Hemlock Talisman 747 on the account test's formula (AccountFormula.Counts, the dats), Values 10 and 5 (weenie_properties_int type 19), sold by Archmage Cindrue 2304 (weenie_properties_create_list rows 20989 and 21023, destination 4) at ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1) = 14 and 7, one each, no trip line and no stop line, as the Lodge's: a missing one drops the level by name (LevelFloor); read on the read-only world copy 2026-11-12. M6 7 AD: the dance's lines (Stamina to Mana Self I on the account test's formula: Lead Scarab, Saffron, Powdered Amber, Quicksilver, Willow Talisman; the Lead Scarab line trips and stops under 1 (she comes with the outskirts' keep of 10 and a press burns one in a thousand) because Drain Health Other I burns one and GearKit.CastBurns reads every stock line of a cast; ComponentLoss 0.01 x CDM 1 for a herb or powder, 0.1 for a scarab or talisman): trip_under 0 and stop_under 0 as M6 7 X's lines: they call no trip and stop no run, a press short of one leaves the rest to the regeneration, named. 140 presses an hour burn 1.4 of each herb and powder, so keep 4 is nearly three hours between trips. M6 3 p1, sized from the rung 'burrow' as the outskirts profile was (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.supplies): the modelled rate is twice the move-on floor, 120 kills an hour, at the move-on ceiling of 4.9 casts a kill (ladder/war-mage.json) = 588 casts an hour, all of them Flame Bolt II as the worst case, 2 Prismatic Tapers a cast on the foci formula = 1176 tapers an hour. Prismatic Taper 20631 (Archmage Cindrue, 30): keep 200 = 10 minutes of that burn rounded up to 50 (capped at 1,000, a stack's limit; 6 burden each, and the capacity is the climber's Strength, TODO(m6-climber-strength)), trip_under 60 (a third of the keep), stop_under 3 (a cast needs 2). Scarabs (Cindrue: Iron 689 at 68, Copper 686 at 135, Silver 688 at 338, the draft's town half, Value x 1.35): the cap level's keep 20, trip_under 5, stop_under 2; a lower level's keep 10, trip_under 3; no spell here burns more than ComponentLoss 0.05 x CDM 0.1 = 0.005 a cast (Flame Bolt II's 0.05, Spell.TryBurnComponents, Spell.cs 157-189 @95ef426d; III to V unmeasured, TODO(m6-component-loss-iii-v)), so 20 scarabs last 6.8 hours at 588 casts an hour. The Copper Scarab 686 is on every spine profile at keep 20, trip_under 5, stop_under 2 (the Temple 40+'s line): the four travel spells (Lifestone Recall and Tie, Primary Portal Tie and Recall) burn one a cast on the foci formula, and GearKit.CastBurns refuses a ground that cannot buy it (GrantsCountedTests). Mana Potion 379 (Thelnoth, 230): keep 5, trip_under 2, stop_under 0, the outskirts' reserve. One restock from nothing at these keeps is 11,210 pyreals at the vendors' prices; purse: coin 12,000 (that rounded up to 1,000, the floor the coin is kept at as the outskirts' is), notes of min_note 10,000 and up (the surplus is kept as bonded notes: a death takes half the coin and no note, Player_Death.cs:347-360 @95ef426d), the one note listed is the outskirts' placeholder count 1 (TODO(m6-purse-note-count)). kit: none, as the outskirts' (the Pathwarden robe and the Training Wand serve; a kit line would put the ground into the level-80 buff-kit checks of GrantsCountedTests and MageBuildScenarioTests); the floor's Wand and Faran Robe with Hood stay sold by Cindrue and Ecutha for GearFloor; burden_trip_percent 150 as the outskirts'. M6 3 F3: the account formula's lines (herbs, powders, talismans, coloured tapers) are stock lines at keep 2, trip_under 2, stop_under 2, the outskirts' rule for them (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.supplies): a backup the focus-holding climber does not burn, a rung's cost of about 250 pyreals the first restock, inside the purse (see components) M6 7 V (the r1h climb: at level 10 with 14 coin the counters called the Mana Potion trip over and over, and one trip spent 9,907 on 198 items): trip_spend_percent 60: one trip's stock buys spend at most 60 percent of the purse (coin and note faces), so the coin for the next trip stays (ResupplyPlanner.BuyList buys the lines under their trip lines first, the components before the potion, then tops up to the keeps in the same order); a trip line whose price the purse cannot pay is held back (LogisticsCounters, logged once a line), so the fight goes on. Rung scale: Iron Scarab keep 6, trip_under 3 (0.005 lost a cast x 588 casts an hour = 2.9 an hour, so 6 is 2 hours; 20 was 6.8 hours at 1,360 pyreals); Copper Scarab keep 10, trip_under 5 (the travel spells burn one a cast, a trip about 4 casts, so 10 is 2 trips and a margin; 20 cost 2,700); Mana Potion keep 2, trip_under 1, stop_under 0 (230 each: the reserve is one potion a trip, a level 10 mage has no spare coin for 5). The Prismatic Taper stays 200 (100 casts of the foci formula's 2, the modelled 588 casts an hour is 10 minutes; the r1e log's 40 kills an hour at level 10 x 4 casts x 2 = 320 an hour is 37 minutes), its 6,000 is first in the order and inside the 60 percent only with the coin of a level-10 climber's loot. M6 7 X (spells are the armor): the stock lines of Armor Self, Bludgeoning Protection Self and Mana Renewal Self II and III on the account test's formula (AccountFormula.Counts: no focus of Life Magic is held; SpellFormulaRules.CustomizeForAccount over the dats, pinned by HuntingGroundDatTests.A_climbers_low_grounds_carry_the_protective_lines_formula): keep 2 (two casts: the formula burns a component only at ComponentLoss 0.05 x CDM 0.1 a cast, Spell.TryBurnComponents, Spell.cs 157-189 @95ef426d, and a buff is cast twice an hour), trip_under 0 (a trip that happens buys them and none is called for them: r2b's trip the moment she arrived, as the Mana Potion line), stop_under 0 (a buff short of a component steps down a level, BuffCycle.Choose; it never ends the run). Each is a row of Archmage Cindrue's create list (weenie 2304, destination 4: Violet 21042, Green 21038, Brown 21043, Blue 21040, Turquoise 21039, Orange 21036, White 21044, Wormwood 20994, Mugwort 20990, Cobalt 21011, Vitriol 21019, Gypsum 21013, Powdered Amber 20997, Cedar Talisman 21031, Willow Talisman 21030; Value 25 a taper, 10 a herb, 5 the rest; price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1)): 34, 14, 7). M6 7 AR (rung at 16; the sentences above are the level 10 rung's): the stock is the Lodge's list, the same Holtburg shops and the same buff lines, at this rung's scale: Prismatic Taper keep 200, trip_under 60, stop_under 4 (a Flame Bolt III cast needs 3; the Burrow's 30 kills an hour at most x 4 casts x 0.15 tapers burnt = 18 an hour, she holds about 390); Iron Scarab keep 6 as before; Copper Scarab keep 5, trip_under 1, stop_under 1 and Silver Scarab keep 3, trip_under 1, stop_under 0: the audit's row 19: one Silver pays Armor Self IV or Bludgeoning Protection Self IV, so one scarab lets a line lapse with no trip called: 3 or more where a III or IV line is wanted, a trip at none. The Burrow's own gate (ladder rung_gates) wants both lines up. M6 14 T (the owner, 2026-11-11: carry health drinks): Potion of Healing 377 (Thelnoth Cort the Healer; BoostValue 25 on Health, Value 170, burden 15; 230 pyreals by the price rule): keep 30, trip_under 6, stop_under 0, listed before the Mana Potion so a short trip budget fills it first. Sized from the live hits of 2026-11-11 in the Tusker Cave (886 hits, mean 3.79, the largest plain hit 9, criticals of 13 and 18; 8 to 11.6 health a second with a pack on her at health 114): a drink from the magic stance takes 2.5 s, so one Potion of Healing is 10 health a second, about what such a pack deals, and the 20 to 30 s a way out takes are 8 to 12 drinks; keep 30 is two to three of those and trip_under 6 is half of one (a trip the purse cannot pay is held back, LogisticsCounters.IsHeldBack). The fight drinks one only when the mana pays no heal or the next hit kills (HealthDrinks.Emergency), so the stock is a reserve and not a ration. Thelnoth sells no Health Tincture 27319 (50 health, 20 health a second): the nearest seller by the travel file is Ludora the Healer 2229 in Dryreach, a trip not built (TODO(m6-health-tincture-trip)); the Health Draught 2457 he also sells restores 10, 4 health a second, under what three tuskers deal, and is not stocked. The purse's coin is 34,000 (it was 30,000): the first fill of every sold line with the thirty Potions of Healing (6,900) stays inside the coin and the one note (HuntingGroundTests, the first-fill check). M6 14 T (the owner, 2026-11-11: Mana Tinctures too): the Mana Potion keeps 100 (it was 120): the Mana Tincture of the town stock (30, bought at the stop in Dryreach) is the main mana drink while held, and the potions are the fallback for a short purse, a failed stop and the top-ups of 25 to 49 missing; 100 of them are 2,500 mana, one stretch between trips at the Cave's 4,000 an hour, and the four drinks together weigh 4,050. The Health Tincture's stop is built (the town_stock section; TODO(m6-health-tincture-trip) closed).

town_stock.name: Mana Tincture
town_stock.source: M6 14 T (the owner, 2026-11-11: Mana Tinctures too): Ludora's create list (destination 4) holds the Mana Tincture 27322 (BoostValue 50 on Mana, Value 500, burden 50): 775 pyreals at her SellPrice 1.55; a SELECT on the world copy. It is the main mana drink while held (ManaDrinks: the biggest drink that fits whole in the missing mana). keep 30, trip_under 10: the Tusker Cave drank about 4,000 mana an hour on 2026-11-11 between trips about 35 minutes apart, 2,333 mana a stretch; 30 tinctures are 1,500 mana and the 100 Mana Potions of the home walk 2,500, so the two cover a stretch and two thirds of the next, and the potions alone still cover one when the stop fails or the purse holds it back. The burden: 30 x 50 + 100 x 15 + 12 x 50 + 30 x 15 = 4,050 for the four drinks.

loot.source: M6 7 lead (2026-11-07, live: the tusk dropped and the pack had no slot; 160 refused pick-ups): min_free_slots 3: the pack keeps room for what a quest needs. M6 7 lead (2026-11-06, live): a sale trip from a dungeon costs about 14 minutes, so sale_trip_value is 100,000 here, not 15,000: the trio at the Lodge paid about 19,000, and a trip a fight left 3 kills in 14 minutes. fight.source: M6 7 AX: retreat_health_percent 40, not AR's 0: AR's 0 stood for a retreat below Lifestone Recall, a walk past the hall; she holds the recall now, and it reads the Artifice focus. Five Female Tuskers at her kit deal about 6.3 health a second (mean live hit 3.79 x 0.951, a swing about 2.85 s); about 4 s to leave costs about 25 of the 36 health at 40% of 90. If a recall is refused she walks: the exit portal 0x57480100 lies under the south hall, so that walk runs through the pack she just woke and is not expected to live: the retreat is the recall or nothing (m6-burrow-exit-under-hall, TODO(m6-tusk-pull-live)). The rest of this note is AR's. M6 7 AR (the rung at 16, the owner's correction of 2026-11-06): as the Lodge: it stands and fights: retreat_health_percent 0 (a retreat below Lifestone Recall is a walk through tuskers to the exit under the south hall, then the island; the upkeep health stop is off, 0 = never), the drain at or below 50% and the mana loop are the ladder's vitals on every ground. pull_full_percent 100 (M6 7 AN, the owner: only enter the dungeon and only pull the next pack with full stamina and mana): read before the entry portal and before every pull, each with a named check. pull_mana_percent 60: a pull at level 16 costs about 4 casts of Flame Bolt III at 15 mana (3 hits on 95 health and one fizzle or resist; the mana cost is a planning value, TODO(m6-burrow-16-live): nothing has been measured here at 16) plus 2 heals at 15 to 25 = about 100 of 165 mana, 60%. pull_health_percent 70: over the emergency floor of 60%. pull_rest_until_percent 90. pull_rest_posture lie: she lies down (ACE GetStanceMod x3 lying, x2.5 sitting, mana x1, Creature_Vitals.cs:210-236 @95ef426d), the press is the mana's engine. pull_aggro_metres 24: VisualAwarenessRange (PropertyFloat 31) of Female Tusker 236. The history: M6 7 lead's r3 and AB's r3d read at level 10 the same shape: a body at 17 of 48 died on the walk out, the second fight began at 46 of 133 mana and ran dry in 12 s.

stand.source: M6 7 AX (the owner's decision: the Female Tusk counts as gate A's tusk, which changes D76, whose tusk was the Lodge's Male Tusk). The stand is 0x5748013D (103.84, -115.50, -15.30), not the overlook cells 0x0142 or 0x0149 the brief named: their free shots reach only the 6-pack holders 8 and 11; this point on the same raised floor reaches holder 6, a 5-pack, at 35.1 m with only slot 34 awake (cache/m6/7/burrow-survey/sampling.txt line 3). That clear line is one sample of a noisy sweep: on 546 floor points here none was clear on all 18 jittered samples, even at 15 m, so the shot does not read the sweep; the server sending the holder is the check, and a bolt that hits the ledge ends the pull by name (shot-blocked). It stands 1.2 m outside the 24 m of slots 5 and 7, in three dimensions. Model, cache/m6/7/ax/out.txt, her kit of 2026-11-06 at health 90 and mana 200: about 1 percent death a try; 47 percent if a Female's hits are twice the Male's measured ones, unmeasured at this kit: TODO(m6-tusk-pull-live). from_level 16: the Burrow's own band; to_level 29: from level 30 the keep-out is off and the plain hunt reaches the hall. wait_s 420: the generator's delay 300 and tick 60 (the profile's respawn) and one tick more. tries 2: a shot sent counts, a death with it; past that the job is not called this session.

hunt.source: M6 7 AR (cache/m6/7/tusk-survey.md): the south hall, cells 0x57480105 to 0x57480114 at z -24, holds nine of the 42 slots (5 to 13) and every tusk holder (6, 8, 9, 11, 13), and a hit or a wake there raises a pack of 5, 6 or 9 (the AlertFriendly sets, cache/m6/7/burrow-survey/geometry.txt); the other 33 slots stand in groups of one to four. The survey's model at health 77, Flame Bolt III and the armor lines: 45 percent death to a 5-pack in the open, 91 to a 6-pack, 97 to 100 to the 9-pack. So the plain hunt leaves the hall alone: no pick, no tour walk and no slot of it counts; an attacker from it is still fought (M5 D88). keep_out_under_level 30: health about 132, where the survey puts a 5-pack or 6-pack at 1 to 5 percent; a level 60 hunter of the tusk (the Trophy loopback) walks in as before. pulls is the data choice for the tusk: the 5-pack holders, slots 6 (0x57480106) and 13 (0x57480113), never 9. It is more than a data change: the walk in wakes the hall whole at the corridor, so a pull needs a stand point and one step that shoots from it: TODO(m6-tusk-pull), logged loudly when a due tusk meets the keep-out
